ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: HabHub reads only the health categories you choose so it can update your private goals and permitted group progress.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: HabHub does not write health data unless you explicitly choose a future export feature.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: HabHub uses your camera only when you choose to take a progress photo.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: HabHub uses your photos only when you choose to add a progress update.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: HabHub saves an image only when you choose to export or share it.
